seriesTitle: A Murder at the End of the World

episodes.title: Chapter 1: Homme Fatal
episodes.summary: An amateur sleuth receives a mysterious invitation to a reclusive tech billionaire's secret retreat.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: The Silver Doe
episodes.summary: Darby believes the death she witnessed may, in fact, be murder, but no one believes her. The grief and shock of the events thrust her into remembering her own buried past.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Survivors
episodes.summary: Darby plays the role of the perfect guest in order to covertly investigate the crime. She finds she may be getting closer to the truth when another life is taken.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: Family Secrets
episodes.summary: There's a killer on the loose and nowhere to run with a storm closing in. Darby breaks out of lockdown and discovers the retreat may not be what she thought it was.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: Crypt
episodes.summary: Darby confronts her prime suspect only to find the tables turned and an unexpected alliance formed...Until someone else dies and her own life is threatened.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: Crime Seen
episodes.summary: Darby uncovers the secret retreat within the retreat. In the past, she and Bill come face to face with the Silver Doe Killer

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Retreat
episodes.summary: The remaining guests gather and discover the killer among them.
